# Settings reference

Every setting can be set in the YAML settings file, as an environment variable
(shown under each name) or, for many, with a command-line option. Precedence is
defaults < YAML < environment < command line; see
[runtime configuration](/guides/runtime-configuration). Secret settings are
redacted wherever configuration is printed.

<!-- Generated by `python -m newsworker.settings_doc`; do not edit by hand. -->
## Caching

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_dir`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_CACHE_DIR` | `~/.newsworker/cache` | Directory for cached specs, page content and the watch store. |
| `content_ttl`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_CONTENT_TTL` | `3600` | Seconds a cached page stays fresh; after that it is revalidated. |
| `spec_ttl`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SPEC_TTL` | `0` | Seconds a cached spec stays valid (0 = never expires). |
| `content_cache_max_entries`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_CONTENT_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` | `0` | Maximum cached pages on disk (0 = unbounded). |
| `content_cache_max_bytes`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_CONTENT_CACHE_MAX_BYTES` | `0` | Maximum total size of cached pages in bytes (0 = unbounded). |
| `spec_cache_max_entries`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SPEC_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` | `0` | Maximum cached specs on disk (0 = unbounded). |

## Fetching

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user_agent`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_USER_AGENT` | `newsworker/<version> (+https://github.com/ivbeg/newsworker)` | User-Agent sent with every request. |
| `request_timeout`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Timeout of one HTTP request, in seconds. |
| `max_content_bytes`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MAX_CONTENT_BYTES` | `10485760` | Largest response body accepted, in bytes. |
| `verify_tls`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_VERIFY_TLS` | `true` | Verify TLS certificates. |
| `respect_robots`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RESPECT_ROBOTS` | `true` | Honour robots.txt, including `Crawl-delay` and `Request-rate`. |
| `proxy`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_PROXY` | — | Proxy URL for outgoing requests (empty = direct). Secret: redacted in output. |
| `trust_env_proxy`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_TRUST_ENV_PROXY` | `false` | Honour `HTTP(S)_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY` and `.netrc` from the environment. |
| `extra_headers`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_EXTRA_HEADERS` | `{}` | Extra headers for source pages; never sent to delivery endpoints and dropped on cross-origin redirects. |
| `cookies_file`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_COOKIES_FILE` | — | Netscape/Mozilla cookie jar used for source pages. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `use_async`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_USE_ASYNC` | `false` | Use the aiohttp transport for `batch` (needs the `async` extra). |

## Network policy

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block_private_hosts`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_BLOCK_PRIVATE_HOSTS` | `true` | Refuse loopback, private, link-local, multicast and reserved addresses, checked again when the connection opens. |
| `allowed_hosts`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `[]` | Only these hosts may be fetched (empty = any public host). |
| `allow_private_hosts`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS` | `false` | Allow private addresses for hosts listed in `allowed_hosts`. |
| `redirect_limit`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_REDIRECT_LIMIT` | `5` | Maximum redirects followed per request. |
| `trusted_proxy`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_TRUSTED_PROXY` | `false` | The configured proxy resolves host names itself, so local address checks are skipped. |
| `delivery_max_response_bytes`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DELIVERY_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES` | `1048576` | Largest response read from a delivery endpoint. |

## Politeness

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `per_host_concurrency`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_PER_HOST_CONCURRENCY` | `2` | Requests in flight per site across all workers of the process (0 = unlimited). |
| `per_host_delay`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_PER_HOST_DELAY` | `0.0` | Minimum seconds between requests to one site; robots.txt `Crawl-delay` raises it. |
| `max_host_wait`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MAX_HOST_WAIT` | `30.0` | Longest wait, in seconds, for a slot or a `Retry-After` window before the request fails as rate limited. |

## Extraction

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filtered_text_length`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_FILTERED_TEXT_LENGTH` | `150` | Longest text node considered as a date candidate. |
| `default_language`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE` | — | Feed language to report instead of detecting it. |
| `default_timezone`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE` | `UTC` | IANA time zone for dates printed without an offset. |
| `structured_data`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_STRUCTURED_DATA` | `true` | Use JSON-LD and microdata article lists when the page has them. |
| `native_feeds`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_NATIVE_FEEDS` | `true` | Read RSS, Atom and JSON Feed responses as feeds. |
| `full_text`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_FULL_TEXT` | `false` | Fetch every item link and store the article body (`fulltext` extra). |
| `full_text_workers`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_FULL_TEXT_WORKERS` | `4` | Concurrent fetches for full text. |
| `bridges_dir`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_BRIDGES_DIR` | — | Directory of user site bridges (empty = `~/.newsworker/bridges`). |
| `undated_fallback`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_UNDATED_FALLBACK` | `false` | Try the conservative undated-listing fallback when no dates are found. |
| `undated_min_items`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_UNDATED_MIN_ITEMS` | `3` | Fewest repeated cards the undated fallback accepts. |
| `undated_min_confidence`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_UNDATED_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | `0.75` | Lowest confidence (0–1) the undated fallback accepts. |

## Browser rendering

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RENDER` | `false` | Render every page in a headless browser (`browser` extra). |
| `render_fallback`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RENDER_FALLBACK` | `false` | Render only when nothing was found and the page looks client-rendered. |
| `render_timeout`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RENDER_TIMEOUT` | `15` | Seconds allowed for one page render. |
| `render_concurrency`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RENDER_CONCURRENCY` | `1` | Pages rendered at the same time. |
| `render_max_bytes`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RENDER_MAX_BYTES` | `10485760` | Largest rendered document accepted, in bytes. |

## Feed server

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Interface `serve` binds to. |
| `port`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_PORT` | `8787` | Port `serve` listens on. |
| `api_tokens`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_API_TOKENS` | `[]` | Tokens accepted on `/feed` and `/metrics` (empty = no token required). Secret: redacted in output. |
| `feed_signing_key`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_FEED_SIGNING_KEY` | — | Key for signed `/feed` links (`newsworker feed-url`); at least 16 characters. Setting it makes `/feed` require a token or a signature. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `public_base_url`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | — | Base URL readers use to reach the server, for self links and `feed-url`. |
| `rate_limit_per_minute`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `0` | Requests per minute per client (0 = no limit). |
| `rate_limit_burst`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_RATE_LIMIT_BURST` | `20` | Requests a client may make at once before the rate limit applies. |
| `max_concurrent_builds`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT_BUILDS` | `8` | Feeds built at the same time; more requests get `503`. |
| `cors_allowed_origins`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `[]` | Origins allowed to call the server from a browser. |
| `trust_proxy_client_ip`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_TRUST_PROXY_CLIENT_IP` | `false` | Identify clients by `X-Forwarded-For` (only behind a trusted reverse proxy). |
| `metrics_enabled`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_METRICS_ENABLED` | `false` | Serve Prometheus metrics at `/metrics` (`metrics` extra). |

## Watch and delivery

| Setting | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `watch_interval`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_WATCH_INTERVAL` | `300.0` | Seconds between polls of `watch`. |
| `watch_max_pages`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_WATCH_MAX_PAGES` | `1` | Pages followed per poll. |
| `delivery_retries`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DELIVERY_RETRIES` | `3` | Attempts before a delivery is marked terminal. |
| `delivery_backoff`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DELIVERY_BACKOFF` | `1.0` | Base seconds of the exponential retry backoff. |
| `delivered_retention_days`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DELIVERED_RETENTION_DAYS` | `30` | Days delivered outbox records are kept. |
| `history_retention_days`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS` | `365` | Days item history is kept after an item was last seen (0 = forever). |
| `smtp_host`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SMTP_HOST` | — | SMTP server for the `smtp` channel. |
| `smtp_port`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SMTP_PORT` | `587` | SMTP port. |
| `smtp_username`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SMTP_USERNAME` | — | SMTP login. |
| `smtp_password`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SMTP_PASSWORD` | — | SMTP password. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `smtp_from`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SMTP_FROM` | — | Sender address of `smtp` messages. |
| `telegram_token`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_TELEGRAM_TOKEN` | — | Bot token for the `telegram` channel. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `slack_webhook_url`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` | — | Incoming-webhook URL for the `slack` channel. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `discord_webhook_url`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | — | Webhook URL for the `discord` channel. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `matrix_homeserver`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MATRIX_HOMESERVER` | — | Homeserver URL for the `matrix` channel. |
| `matrix_token`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MATRIX_TOKEN` | — | Access token for the `matrix` channel. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `matrix_room`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MATRIX_ROOM` | — | Room id for the `matrix` channel, e.g. `!abc:example.org`. |
| `mastodon_instance`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MASTODON_INSTANCE` | — | Instance URL for the `mastodon` channel. |
| `mastodon_token`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MASTODON_TOKEN` | — | Access token with `write:statuses` for the `mastodon` channel. Secret: redacted in output. |
| `mastodon_visibility`<br/>`NEWSWORKER_MASTODON_VISIBILITY` | `unlisted` | Post visibility: `public`, `unlisted`, `private` or `direct`. |
